If you're trying to run your application locally and getting issues with port 3000, here are some common solutions:

1. **Start the development server**
   ```bash
   # If using React
   npm start
   
   # If using Next.js
   npm run dev
   
   # If using Yarn instead of npm
   yarn start
   # or
   yarn dev
   ```

2. **If the port is already in use**, you can either:
   - Kill the process using port 3000:
     ```bash
     # On Windows
     netstat -ano | findstr :3000
     taskkill /PID <PID> /F

     # On Mac/Linux
     lsof -i :3000
     kill -9 <PID>
     ```
   - Or use a different port:
     ```bash
     # Windows
     set PORT=3001 && npm start

     # Mac/Linux
     PORT=3001 npm start
     ```


   1. Open System Settings (or System Preferences)
   2. Go to Privacy & Security
   3. Click on Full Disk Access in the left sidebar
   4. Click the lock icon at the bottom to make changes (enter your password)
   5. Click the + button
   6. Navigate to Applications > Utilities
   7. Select Terminal.app
   8. Enable the checkbox next to Terminal

```typescript:components/overview.tsx
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes';

export const Overview = () => {
  const { theme } = useTheme();

  return (
    <motion.div
      key="overview"
      className="max-w-3xl mx-auto md:mt-20"
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
      transition={{ delay: 0.5 }}
    >
      <div className="rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-8 leading-relaxed text-center max-w-xl">
        <div className="flex justify-center">
          <Image
            src={theme === 'dark' 
              ? '/images/Hang-Logo-Full-White (1).png'
              : '/images/Hang-Logo-Full-RichBlack.png'
            }
            alt="Hang Logo"
            width={200}
            height={50}
            priority
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};
```

Key changes made:
1. Added `import { useTheme } from 'next-themes'`
2. Added the `useTheme` hook to detect dark mode
3. Updated the Image `src` to conditionally render different logos based on the theme

The white logo will now show in dark mode, while the black logo will show in light mode. Let me know if you need any adjustments!

```typescript:components/dashboard/dashboard-tool.tsx
        </h3>
```

4. Let's create the API route:

```typescript:app/api/dashboard/route.ts
import { auth } from '@/auth';
import { db } from '@/db';
import { nanoid } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type Dashboard } from '@/types/dashboard';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const session = await auth();
    if (!session?.user) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    const json = await req.json();
    const { title, content } = json;

    const dashboard: Dashboard = {
      id: nanoid(),
      title,
      content,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
      userId: session.user.id
    };

    await db.dashboard.create({
      data: dashboard
    });

    return new Response(JSON.stringify(dashboard), { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response('Internal Server Error', { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

5. Create the dashboard editor page:

```typescript:app/(auth)/dashboard/page.tsx

  }

    <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden">
      <DashboardEditor user={session.user} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript:components/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx
'use client';

import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  BarChart as RechartsBarChart,
  Bar,
  PieChart as RechartsPieChart,
  Pie,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
} from 'recharts';

const sampleData = {
  'sales-metrics': {
    title: 'Sales Metrics',
    data: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({
      name: `Month ${i + 1}`,
      value: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
    })),
  },
  'user-analytics': {
    title: 'User Analytics',
    data: Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => ({
      name: `Category ${i + 1}`,
      value: Math.floor(Math.random() * 100),
    })),
  },
  'market-share': {
    title: 'Market Share',
    data: Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => ({
      name: `Product ${i + 1}`,
      value: Math.floor(Math.random() * 100),
    })),
  },
  'performance': {
    title: 'Performance Metrics',
    data: Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({
      name: `Hour ${i + 1}`,
      value: Math.floor(Math.random() * 100),
    })),
  },
};

export function DashboardView({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const dashboard = sampleData[id as keyof typeof sampleData];
  
  if (!dashboard) {
    return <div>Dashboard not found</div>;
  }

  const renderChart = () => {
    switch (id) {
      case 'sales-metrics':
        return (
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={400}>
            <LineChart data={dashboard.data}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="name" />
              <YAxis />
              <Tooltip />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="value" stroke="#8884d8" />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        );
      case 'user-analytics':
        return (
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={400}>
            <RechartsBarChart data={dashboard.data}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="name" />
              <YAxis />
              <Tooltip />
              <Bar dataKey="value" fill="#82ca9d" />
            </RechartsBarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        );
      case 'market-share':
        return (
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={400}>
            <RechartsPieChart>
              <Pie
                data={dashboard.data}
                dataKey="value"
                nameKey="name"
                cx="50%"
                cy="50%"
                fill="#8884d8"
              />
              <Tooltip />
            </RechartsPieChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={400}>
            <LineChart data={dashboard.data}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="name" />
              <YAxis />
              <Tooltip />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="value" stroke="#82ca9d" />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card className="p-6">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">{dashboard.title}</h2>
        {renderChart()}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript:lib/ai/tools/query-data.ts
import { tool } from 'ai';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { sql } from '@vercel/postgres';
// Or your preferred data warehouse client
// import { createClient } from '@snowflake-sdk/client';
// import { BigQuery } from '@google-cloud/bigquery';

export const queryData = tool({
  name: 'queryData',
  description: 'Query business data and return results',
  parameters: z.object({
    query: z.string().describe('SQL query to execute'),
    visualization: z.enum(['table', 'line', 'bar', 'pie']).optional()
      .describe('Type of visualization to create from the data'),
  }),
  execute: async ({ query, visualization }) => {
    try {
      // Execute query safely (with proper SQL injection prevention)
      const result = await sql.query(query);
      
      // Format results for visualization if requested
      if (visualization) {
        return {
          data: result.rows,
          visualization: visualization,
          columns: result.fields.map(f => f.name)
        };
      }

      return result.rows;
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        error: 'Failed to execute query',
        details: error.message
      };
    }
  }
});
```

Add visualization component:

```typescript:components/data-visualization.tsx
'use client';

import {
  LineChart,
  BarChart as RechartsBarChart,
  Line,
  Bar,
  PieChart,
  Pie,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer
} from 'recharts';

interface DataVisualizationProps {
  data: any[];
  type: 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';
  columns: string[];
}

export function DataVisualization({ data, type, columns }: DataVisualizationProps) {
  const renderChart = () => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'line':
        return (
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={400}>
            <LineChart data={data}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey={columns[0]} />
              <YAxis />
              <Tooltip />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey={columns[1]} stroke="#8884d8" />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        );
      case 'bar':
        return (
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={400}>
            <RechartsBarChart data={data}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey={columns[0]} />
              <YAxis />
              <Tooltip />
              <Bar dataKey={columns[1]} fill="#82ca9d" />
            </RechartsBarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        );
      case 'pie':
        return (
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={400}>
            <PieChart>
              <Pie
                data={data}
                dataKey={columns[1]}
                nameKey={columns[0]}
                cx="50%"
                cy="50%"
                fill="#8884d8"
              />
              <Tooltip />
            </PieChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return renderChart();
}
```

```typescript:lib/db/setup-warehouse.ts
async function setupDatabase() {

        name VARCHAR(100),
        category VARCHAR(50),
        price DECIMAL(10,2),
        stock_quantity INTEGER
      );

        country VARCHAR(50),
        joined_date DATE
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        product_id INTEGER REFERENCES products(id),
        customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(id),
        sale_date DATE,
        quantity INTEGER,
        total_amount DECIMAL(10,2)
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employee_performance (

        employee_name VARCHAR(100),
        department VARCHAR(50),
        sales_target DECIMAL(10,2),

      ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

      INSERT INTO sales (product_id, customer_id, sale_date, quantity, total_amount)
```

```typescript:lib/db/setup-warehouse.ts
);

  try {

    await supabase.from('customers').delete();
    await supabase.from('sales').delete();
    await supabase.from('employee_performance').delete();

    // Create tables using Supabase's interface or run these SQL commands:
    const { error: createError } = await supabase.rpc('setup_warehouse_tables', {
      sql: `
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
          id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
          name VARCHAR(100),
          category VARCHAR(50),
          price DECIMAL(10,2),
          stock_quantity INTEGER
        );

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
          id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
          name VARCHAR(100),
          email VARCHAR(100),
          country VARCHAR(50),
          joined_date DATE
        );

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales (
          id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
          product_id INTEGER REFERENCES products(id),
          customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(id),
          sale_date DATE,
          quantity INTEGER,
          total_amount DECIMAL(10,2)
        );

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employee_performance (
          id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
          employee_name VARCHAR(100),
          department VARCHAR(50),
          sales_target DECIMAL(10,2),
          sales_achieved DECIMAL(10,2),
          evaluation_date DATE
        );
      `
    });

    if (createError) throw createError;

    // Insert sample data
    const { error: productsError } = await supabase
      .from('products')
      .insert([
        { name: 'Laptop Pro', category: 'Electronics', price: 1299.99, stock_quantity: 50 },
        { name: 'Smartphone X', category: 'Electronics', price: 899.99, stock_quantity: 100 },
        { name: 'Office Chair', category: 'Furniture', price: 199.99, stock_quantity: 30 },
        { name: 'Coffee Maker', category: 'Appliances', price: 79.99, stock_quantity: 25 },
        { name: 'Wireless Earbuds', category: 'Electronics', price: 159.99, stock_quantity: 75 }
      ]);

    if (productsError) throw productsError;

    const { error: customersError } = await supabase
      .from('customers')
      .insert([
        { name: 'John Smith', email: 'john@example.com', country: 'USA', joined_date: '2023-01-15' },
        { name: 'Emma Wilson', email: 'emma@example.com', country: 'UK', joined_date: '2023-02-20' },

        { name: 'Alex Chen', email: 'alex@example.com', country: 'Canada', joined_date: '2023-05-01' }
      ]);

    if (customersError) throw customersError;

    // ... similar inserts for sales and employee_performance

    console.log('Database setup completed successfully');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error setting up database:', error);
  }
}

setupDatabase();
```

```typescript:lib/ai/tools/query-data.ts
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { tool } from 'ai';
import { z } from 'zod';

const supabase = createClient(
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
  process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!
);

export const queryData = tool({
  name: 'queryData',
  description: 'Query business data and return results',
  parameters: z.object({
    query: z.string().describe('SQL query to execute'),
    visualization: z.enum(['table', 'line', 'bar', 'pie']).optional()
      .describe('Type of visualization to create from the data'),
  }),
  execute: async ({ query, visualization }) => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('run_warehouse_query', { sql: query });
      
      if (error) throw error;

      if (visualization) {
        return {
          data,
          visualization,
          columns: data.length > 0 ? Object.keys(data[0]) : []
        };
      }

      return data;
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        error: 'Failed to execute query',
        details: error.message
      };
    }
  }
});
```

You'll need to:

1. Create a new Supabase database function for safe SQL execution:
```sql
create or replace function run_warehouse_query(sql text)
returns json
language plpgsql
security definer
as $$
begin
  return (select json_agg(t) from (select * from dblink('dbname=postgres', sql) as t) t);
end;
$$;
```

2. Use your existing Supabase environment variables:
```bash
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=your_supabase_url
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=your_service_role_key
```

```typescript:lib/db/test-warehouse.ts
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';

dotenv.config({ path: '.env.local' });

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseKey) {
  throw new Error(
    'Missing environment variables. Please ensure NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are set.'
  );
}

const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey);

async function testDatabaseConnection() {
  try {
    // Test simple query
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('run_warehouse_query', {
      sql: `
        SELECT json_agg(
          json_build_object(
            'product_count', count(*)
          )
        ) as result
        FROM products
      `
    });

    if (error) {
      console.error('Database test failed:', error.message);
      return;
    }

    console.log('Database connection successful!');
    console.log('Number of products:', data.result[0].product_count);

    // Test a more complex query
    const { data: salesData, error: salesError } = await supabase.rpc('run_warehouse_query', {
      sql: `
        SELECT json_agg(
          json_build_object(
            'category', category,
            'total_sales', total_sales
          )
        ) as result
        FROM (
          SELECT 
            p.category,
            SUM(s.total_amount) as total_sales
          FROM sales s
          JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id
          GROUP BY p.category
        ) subq
      `
    });

    if (salesError) {
      console.error('Sales query failed:', salesError.message);
      return;
    }

    console.log('\nSales by category:', salesData.result);

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Test failed:', error);
  }
}

testDatabaseConnection();
```

```typescript:components/data-visualization/query-result.tsx
'use client';

import {
  LineChart,
  BarChart,
  Line,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  PieChart,
  Pie,
  Cell
} from 'recharts';
import { Table } from '@/components/ui/table';

const COLORS = ['#8884d8', '#82ca9d', '#ffc658', '#ff7300', '#0088fe'];

interface QueryResultProps {
  data: any;
  visualization?: 'table' | 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';
}

export function QueryResult({ data, visualization = 'table' }: QueryResultProps) {
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
    return <div>No data available</div>;
  }

  // Handle array results (like our sales by category)
  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
    switch (visualization) {
      case 'bar':
        return (
          <div className="h-[400px] w-full">
            <ResponsiveContainer>
              <BarChart data={data}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
                <XAxis dataKey={Object.keys(data[0])[0]} />
                <YAxis />
                <Tooltip />
                <Bar dataKey={Object.keys(data[0])[1]} fill="#8884d8" />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        );

      case 'pie':
        return (
          <div className="h-[400px] w-full">
            <ResponsiveContainer>
              <PieChart>
                <Pie
                  data={data}
                  nameKey={Object.keys(data[0])[0]}
                  dataKey={Object.keys(data[0])[1]}
                  cx="50%"
                  cy="50%"
                  outerRadius={150}
                  label
                >
                  {data.map((_, index) => (
                    <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={COLORS[index % COLORS.length]} />
                  ))}
                </Pie>
                <Tooltip />
              </PieChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        );

      case 'line':
        return (
          <div className="h-[400px] w-full">
            <ResponsiveContainer>
              <LineChart data={data}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
                <XAxis dataKey={Object.keys(data[0])[0]} />
                <YAxis />
                <Tooltip />
                <Line type="monotone" dataKey={Object.keys(data[0])[1]} stroke="#8884d8" />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        );

      case 'table':
      default:
        return (
          <div className="rounded-md border">
            <Table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {Object.keys(data[0]).map((key) => (
                    <th key={key} className="p-2 text-left">
                      {key}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {data.map((row, i) => (
                  <tr key={i}>
                    {Object.values(row).map((value: any, j) => (
                      <td key={j} className="p-2">
                        {typeof value === 'number' ? value.toLocaleString() : value}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </Table>
          </div>
        );
    }
  }

  // Handle single value or object results
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border p-4">
      <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
        {JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)}
      </pre>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Let's create the ColorPicker component:

```typescript:components/data-visualization/color-picker.tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '@/components/ui/popover';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface ColorPickerProps {
  colors: string[];
  onChange: (colors: string[]) => void;
}

export function ColorPicker({ colors, onChange }: ColorPickerProps) {
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const handleColorChange = (color: string, index: number) => {
    const newColors = [...colors];
    newColors[index] = color;
    onChange(newColors);
  };

  const addColor = () => {
    onChange([...colors, '#000000']);
  };

  const removeColor = (index: number) => {
    const newColors = colors.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    onChange(newColors);
    if (selectedIndex === index) {
      setSelectedIndex(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      {colors.map((color, index) => (
        <Popover key={index}>
          <PopoverTrigger asChild>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className={cn(
                "h-8 w-8 p-0",
                selectedIndex === index && "ring-2 ring-primary"
              )}
              style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
              onClick={() => setSelectedIndex(index)}
            >
              <span className="sr-only">Pick color {index + 1}</span>
            </Button>
          </PopoverTrigger>
          <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-2">
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Input
                type="color"
                value={color}
                onChange={(e) => handleColorChange(e.target.value, index)}
                className="h-8 w-16"
              />
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => removeColor(index)}
                disabled={colors.length <= 1}
              >
                Remove
              </Button>
            </div>
          </PopoverContent>
        </Popover>
      ))}
      
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        className="h-8 w-8 p-0"
        onClick={addColor}
        disabled={colors.length >= 10}
      >
        +
        <span className="sr-only">Add color</span>
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

1. Color swatches that can be clicked to edit
2. Color input using the native color picker
3. Ability to add/remove colors
4. Maximum of 10 colors
5. At least one color required
6. Accessible labels and keyboard navigation

```typescript:components/chat.tsx
import type { Attachment, Message } from 'ai';

import useSWR, { useSWRConfig } from 'swr';
import { ChatHeader } from '@/components/chat-header';
import type { Vote } from '@/lib/db/schema';
import { fetcher, generateUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Artifact } from './artifact';
import { MultimodalInput } from './multimodal-input';
import { Messages } from './messages';
import { VisibilityType } from './visibility-selector';
import { useArtifactSelector } from '@/hooks/use-artifact';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { VisualizationPanel } from '@/components/data-visualization/visualization-panel';

interface ChatProps {
  id: string;
  initialMessages: Array<Message>;
  selectedChatModel: string;
  selectedVisibilityType: VisibilityType;
  isReadonly: boolean;
  children?: React.ReactNode; // Changed from function to ReactNode
}

export function Chat({
  id,
  initialMessages,
  selectedChatModel,
  selectedVisibilityType,
  isReadonly,
  children
}: ChatProps) {
  const { mutate } = useSWRConfig();

  const {
    messages,
    setMessages,
    handleSubmit,
    input,
    setInput,
    append,
    isLoading,
    stop,
    reload,
  } = useChat({
    id,
    body: { id, selectedChatModel: selectedChatModel },
    initialMessages,
    experimental_throttle: 100,
    sendExtraMessageFields: true,
    generateId: generateUUID,
    onFinish: () => {
      mutate('/api/history');
    },
    onError: () => {
      toast.error('An error occured, please try again!');
    },
  });

  const { data: votes } = useSWR<Array<Vote>>(
    `/api/vote?chatId=${id}`,
    fetcher,
  );

  const [attachments, setAttachments] = useState<Array<Attachment>>([]);
  const isArtifactVisible = useArtifactSelector((state) => state.isVisible);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0 h-dvh bg-background">
      <ChatHeader
        chatId={id}
        selectedModelId={selectedChatModel}
        selectedVisibilityType={selectedVisibilityType}
        isReadonly={isReadonly}
      />

      <Messages
        chatId={id}
        isLoading={isLoading}
        votes={votes}
        messages={messages}
        setMessages={setMessages}
        reload={reload}
        isReadonly={isReadonly}
        isArtifactVisible={isArtifactVisible}
        renderMessage={(message) => (
          <>
            {message.content}
            {message.data && (
              <div className="mt-4">
                <VisualizationPanel 
                  data={message.data} 
                  visualization={message.visualization}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      />

      <form className="flex mx-auto px-4 bg-background pb-4 md:pb-6 gap-2 w-full md:max-w-3xl">
        {!isReadonly && (
          <MultimodalInput
            chatId={id}
            input={input}
            setInput={setInput}
            handleSubmit={handleSubmit}
            isLoading={isLoading}
            stop={stop}
            attachments={attachments}
            setAttachments={setAttachments}
            messages={messages}
            setMessages={setMessages}
            append={append}
          />
        )}
      </form>

      {children} {/* Render children directly */}

      <Artifact
        chatId={id}
        input={input}
        setInput={setInput}
        handleSubmit={handleSubmit}
        isLoading={isLoading}
        stop={stop}
        attachments={attachments}
        setAttachments={setAttachments}
        append={append}
        messages={messages}
        setMessages={setMessages}
        reload={reload}
        votes={votes}
        isReadonly={isReadonly}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript:lib/ai/tools/query-data.ts
export const queryData = tool({
  name: 'queryData',
  description: 'Query business data and return results',
  parameters: z.object({
    query: z.string().describe('SQL query to execute'),
    visualization: z.enum(['table', 'line', 'bar', 'pie']).optional()
      .describe('Type of visualization to create from the data'),
    title: z.string().optional()
      .describe('Title for the visualization'),
    description: z.string().optional()
      .describe('Description of what the data shows'),
  }),
  execute: async ({ query, visualization, title, description }) => {
    try {
      console.log('Executing query:', query);
      
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('run_warehouse_query_json', { 
        sql: query 
      });
      
      if (error) {
        console.error('Query error:', error);
        throw error;
      }

      // Format numbers for display
      const formattedData = formatDataForDisplay(data);

      return {
        data: formattedData,
        visualization,
        title,
        description,
        message: 'Query executed successfully'
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Tool error:', error);
      throw new Error(`Query failed: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
});

function formatDataForDisplay(data: any) {
  if (!data) return data;

  // Format numbers
  const formatNumber = (num: number) => {
    if (num >= 1000000) {
      return `$${(num / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M`;
    }
    if (num >= 1000) {
      return `$${(num / 1000).toFixed(1)}K`;
    }
    return num.toLocaleString();
  };

  // Recursively format all numbers in the data
  const format = (obj: any): any => {
    if (typeof obj === 'number') {
      return formatNumber(obj);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      return obj.map(format);
    }
    if (typeof obj === 'object' && obj !== null) {
      const result: any = {};
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
        result[key] = format(value);
      }
      return result;
    }
    return obj;
  };

  return format(data);
}
```

```typescript:components/data-visualization/query-display.tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Code } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Collapsible,
  CollapsibleContent,
  CollapsibleTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/collapsible';
import { VisualizationPanel } from './visualization-panel';

interface QueryDisplayProps {
  data: any;
  visualization?: 'table' | 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';
  sql?: string;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export function QueryDisplay({ 
  data, 
  visualization, 
  sql,
  title,
  description 
}: QueryDisplayProps) {
  const [showSql, setShowSql] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {title && (
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">{title}</h3>
      )}
      
      {description && (
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
      )}

      <div className="relative">
        <VisualizationPanel 
          data={data} 
          visualization={visualization}
        />
        
        {sql && (
          <div className="absolute top-2 right-2">
            <Collapsible>
              <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setShowSql(!showSql)}
                >
                  <Code className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {showSql ? 'Hide SQL' : 'Show SQL'}
                </Button>
              </CollapsibleTrigger>
              <CollapsibleContent className="mt-2">
                <pre className="p-4 bg-muted rounded-md text-sm overflow-x-auto">
                  {sql}
                </pre>
              </CollapsibleContent>
            </Collapsible>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
import { CHAT_MODELS, DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL } from '@/lib/ai/models';
import { OpenAIProvider } from '@ai-sdk/openai';
import { FireworksProvider } from '@ai-sdk/fireworks';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const json = await req.json();
  const { messages, id, selectedChatModel = DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL } = json;
  
  // Validate model selection
  if (!CHAT_MODELS[selectedChatModel]) {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ error: `Invalid model: ${selectedChatModel}` }),
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const model = CHAT_MODELS[selectedChatModel];
  
  // Choose provider based on model
  const provider = model instanceof OpenAILanguageModel 
    ? new OpenAIProvider({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY! })
    : new FireworksProvider({ apiKey: process.env.FIREWORKS_API_KEY! });

  try {
    const systemMessage = await getSystemPrompt({
      selectedChatModel,
    });

    const dataStream = new TransformStream();
    const writer = dataStream.writable.getWriter();

    streamText({
      model: provider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      system: systemMessage,
      messages,
      maxSteps: 5,
      tools: [queryData],
      onStart: () => {
        console.log('Stream started');
      },
      onToken: (token) => {
        writer.write(token);
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        console.error('Stream error:', error);
        writer.write({
          type: 'error',
          error: error.message || 'An error occurred during processing'
        });
      },
      // ... rest of the configuration
    });

    return new StreamingTextResponse(dataStream.readable);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ error: 'An error occurred processing your request' }),
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

_**Assistant**_

Let's check the correct way to create language models with the AI SDK. It seems we need to create the providers first:

```typescript:lib/ai/models.ts
import { openai } from '@ai-sdk/openai';
import { fireworks } from '@ai-sdk/fireworks';

// Create providers first
const openaiProvider = openai.createProvider({ 
  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY! 
});

const fireworksProvider = fireworks.createProvider({ 
  apiKey: process.env.FIREWORKS_API_KEY! 
});

export const CHAT_MODELS = {
  'gpt-4': openaiProvider.languageModel('gpt-4-turbo-preview', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
  'gpt-3.5': openaiProvider.languageModel('gpt-3.5-turbo', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
  'claude-3': fireworksProvider.languageModel('accounts/fireworks/models/claude-3-sonnet', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
} as const;

export type ChatModelId = keyof typeof CHAT_MODELS;

export const DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL: ChatModelId = 'gpt-3.5';
```




And update the chat route to use the same providers:

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
import { openai } from '@ai-sdk/openai';
import { fireworks } from '@ai-sdk/fireworks';
import { CHAT_MODELS, DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL } from '@/lib/ai/models';

// Create providers once
const openaiProvider = openai.createProvider({ 
  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY! 
});

const fireworksProvider = fireworks.createProvider({ 
  apiKey: process.env.FIREWORKS_API_KEY! 
});

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    // ... existing code ...

    const model = CHAT_MODELS[selectedChatModel];
    
    // Check if it's an OpenAI model by the model name
    const isOpenAIModel = selectedChatModel.startsWith('gpt-');
    const provider = isOpenAIModel ? openaiProvider : fireworksProvider;

    // ... rest of the code ...

    streamText({
      model: provider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      // ... rest of streamText config ...
    });

    // ... rest of the code ...
  } catch (error) {
    // ... error handling ...
  }
}
```




The key changes are:
1. Creating providers before creating models
2. Using `provider.languageModel()` to create models
3. Using the same provider instances for both model creation and streaming

Let me know if you need any clarification or run into other issues!

```typescript:lib/ai/models.ts
import { OpenAIProvider } from '@ai-sdk/openai';
import { FireworksProvider } from '@ai-sdk/fireworks';

// Create providers first
const openaiProvider = new OpenAIProvider({ 
  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY! 
});

const fireworksProvider = new FireworksProvider({ 
  apiKey: process.env.FIREWORKS_API_KEY! 
});

export const CHAT_MODELS = {
  'gpt-4': openaiProvider.languageModel('gpt-4-turbo-preview', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
  'gpt-3.5': openaiProvider.languageModel('gpt-3.5-turbo', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
  'claude-3': fireworksProvider.languageModel('accounts/fireworks/models/claude-3-sonnet', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
} as const;

export type ChatModelId = keyof typeof CHAT_MODELS;

export const DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL: ChatModelId = 'gpt-3.5';

// Export providers for use in other files
export { openaiProvider, fireworksProvider };
```




And update the chat route to use the exported providers:

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
import { OpenAIProvider } from '@ai-sdk/openai';
import { FireworksProvider } from '@ai-sdk/fireworks';
import { CHAT_MODELS, DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL, openaiProvider, fireworksProvider } from '@/lib/ai/models';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    // ... existing code ...

    const model = CHAT_MODELS[selectedChatModel];
    
    // Check if it's an OpenAI model by the model name
    const isOpenAIModel = selectedChatModel.startsWith('gpt-');
    const provider = isOpenAIModel ? openaiProvider : fireworksProvider;

    // ... rest of the code ...

    streamText({
      model: provider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      // ... rest of streamText config ...
    });

    // ... rest of the code ...
  } catch (error) {
    // ... error handling ...
  }
}
```




The key changes are:
1. Using the provider classes directly instead of namespaces
2. Creating provider instances with `new`
3. Exporting the provider instances for reuse
4. Using the same provider instances across the application

```typescript:lib/ai/models.ts
export { openaiProvider, fireworksProvider };
```

```typescript:lib/ai/models.ts
import { openai } from '@ai-sdk/openai';
import { fireworks } from '@ai-sdk/fireworks';

// Create providers first
const openaiProvider = openai.createProvider({ 
  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY! 
});

const fireworksProvider = fireworks.createProvider({ 
  apiKey: process.env.FIREWORKS_API_KEY! 
});

export const CHAT_MODELS = {
  'gpt-4': openaiProvider.languageModel('gpt-4-turbo-preview', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
  'gpt-3.5': openaiProvider.languageModel('gpt-3.5-turbo', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
  'claude-3': fireworksProvider.languageModel('accounts/fireworks/models/claude-3-sonnet', {
    maxTokens: 4096,
  }),
} as const;

export type ChatModelId = keyof typeof CHAT_MODELS;

export const DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL: ChatModelId = 'gpt-3.5';

// Export providers for use in other files
export { openaiProvider, fireworksProvider };
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
import { type StreamingTextResponse } from 'ai/streaming';
import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { getSystemPrompt } from '@/lib/ai/prompts';
import {
  deleteChatById,
  getChatById,
  saveChat,
  saveMessages,
} from '@/lib/db/queries';
import {
  generateUUID,
  getMostRecentUserMessage,
  sanitizeResponseMessages,
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { createOpenAI } from '@ai-sdk/openai';
import { createFireworks } from '@ai-sdk/fireworks';
import { CHAT_MODELS, DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL, openaiProvider, fireworksProvider } from '@/lib/ai/models';
import { type ChatModelId } from '@/lib/ai/models';

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const {
      id,
      messages,
      selectedChatModel = DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL,
    }: {
      id: string;
      messages: Array<Message>;
      selectedChatModel: ChatModelId; // Use the ChatModelId type
    } = await request.json();

    // ... rest of the imports and setup ...

    const model = CHAT_MODELS[selectedChatModel];
    
    // Check if it's an OpenAI model by the model name
    const isOpenAIModel = selectedChatModel.startsWith('gpt-');
    const provider = isOpenAIModel ? openaiProvider : fireworksProvider;

    const systemMessage = await getSystemPrompt({
      selectedChatModel,
    });

    const dataStream = new TransformStream();
    const writer = dataStream.writable.getWriter();

    streamText({
      model: provider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      system: systemMessage,
      messages,
      maxSteps: 5,
      tools: [queryData],
      onStart: () => {
        console.log('Stream started');
      },
      onToken: (token: string) => { // Add type for token
        writer.write(token);
      },
      onError: (error: { error: unknown; message?: string }) => { // Add type for error
        console.error('Stream error:', error);
        writer.write({
          type: 'error',
          error: error.message || 'An error occurred during processing'
        });
      },
      onFinish: async ({ response, reasoning }) => {
        if (session.user?.id) {
          try {
            console.log('Stream response:', response);
            console.log('Stream reasoning:', reasoning);

            const sanitizedResponseMessages = sanitizeResponseMessages({
              messages: response.messages,
              reasoning,
            });

            await saveMessages({
              messages: sanitizedResponseMessages.map((message) => ({
                id: message.id,
                chatId: id,
                role: message.role,
                content: message.content,
                createdAt: new Date(),
                ...(message.data && { data: message.data }),
                ...(message.visualization && { visualization: message.visualization }),
              })),
            });
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to save chat:', error);
          }
        }
      },
      experimental_telemetry: {
        isEnabled: isProductionEnvironment,
        functionId: 'stream-text',
      },
    });

    return new StreamingTextResponse(dataStream.readable);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

Key changes:
1. Import `StreamingTextResponse` from 'ai/streaming'
2. Use `ChatModelId` type for `selectedChatModel`
3. Add type annotations for callback parameters
4. Use optional chaining for data and visualization properties
5. Use spread operator to conditionally add properties

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
import {
  type Message,
  createDataStreamResponse,
  smoothStream,
  streamText,
  type Tool,
  type ToolSet,
} from 'ai';
import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { getSystemPrompt } from '@/lib/ai/prompts';
// ... rest of imports ...

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    // ... rest of the code ...

    streamText({
      model: provider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      system: systemMessage,
      messages,
      maxSteps: 5,
      tools: { queryData } as ToolSet,
      stream: true, // Enable streaming
      onToken: (token: string) => {
        writer.write(token);
      },
      onError: (error: { error: unknown; message?: string }) => {
        console.error('Stream error:', error);
        writer.write({
          type: 'error',
          error: error.message || 'An error occurred during processing'
        });
      },
      // ... rest of streamText config ...
    });

    // Return a streaming response
    return new Response(dataStream.readable, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
        'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
        'Connection': 'keep-alive',
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
          error: error.message || 'An error occurred during processing'
        });
      },
      // ... rest of streamText config ...
    });

    return new StreamingTextResponse(dataStream.readable);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

2. Remove the `stream: true` option since it's not needed

Looking at the linter errors and comparing with the Vercel AI chatbot repository, we need to update how we handle the streaming response. The `streamText` function has different type expectations than what we're currently using.

Let's update the chat route:

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
import {
  type Message,
  createDataStreamResponse,
  smoothStream,
  streamText,
  type Tool,
  type ToolSet,
} from 'ai';
import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { getSystemPrompt } from '@/lib/ai/prompts';
// ... other imports

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    // ... existing setup code ...

    const dataStream = new TransformStream();
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const writer = dataStream.writable.getWriter();

    // Create a function to handle streaming
    const writeStream = (chunk: string) => {
      writer.write(encoder.encode(`data: ${chunk}\n\n`));
    };

    await streamText({
      model: provider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      system: systemMessage,
      messages,
      maxSteps: 5,
      tools: { queryData } as ToolSet,
      onCompletion: (completion) => {
        writeStream(completion);
      },
      onError: (error: { error: unknown; message?: string }) => {
        console.error('Stream error:', error);
        writeStream(JSON.stringify({
          type: 'error',
          error: error.message || 'An error occurred during processing'
        }));
      },
      onFinish: async ({ response, reasoning }) => {
        if (session.user?.id) {
          try {
            const sanitizedResponseMessages = sanitizeResponseMessages({
              messages: response.messages,
              reasoning,
            });

            await saveMessages({
              messages: sanitizedResponseMessages.map((message) => {
                const baseMessage = {
                  id: message.id,
                  chatId: id,
                  role: message.role,
                  content: message.content,
                  createdAt: new Date(),
                };

                if ('data' in message || 'visualization' in message) {
                  return {
                    ...baseMessage,
                    ...(('data' in message) && { data: message.data }),
                    ...(('visualization' in message) && { visualization: message.visualization }),
                  };
                }

                return baseMessage;
              }),
            });
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to save chat:', error);
          }
        }
        writer.close();
      },
    });

    return new Response(dataStream.readable, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
        'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-transform',
        'Connection': 'keep-alive',
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

Key changes based on [the official repository](https://github.com/vercel/ai-chatbot):
1. Remove `StreamingTextResponse` import since it's not needed
2. Use `TextEncoder` to properly format SSE messages
3. Replace `onToken` with `onCompletion` for proper streaming
4. Add `writer.close()` in `onFinish` to properly end the stream
5. Format stream data with `data: ${chunk}\n\n` for SSE

This matches how the official Vercel AI chatbot handles streaming responses.

```typescript
const handleStream = async (reader: ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array>) => {
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      
      const chunk = decoder.decode(value);
      const lines = chunk.split('\n');
      
      for (const line of lines) {
        if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
          const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
          if (data.type === 'completion') {
            // Handle completion
          } else if (data.type === 'error') {
            // Handle error
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Stream reading failed:', error);
  }
};
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
import {
  type Message,
  streamText,
  type Tool,
  type ToolSet,
} from 'ai';

// ... other imports ...

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    // ... existing setup code ...

    const dataStream = new TransformStream();
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const writer = dataStream.writable.getWriter();

    await streamText({
      model: provider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      system: systemMessage,
      messages,
      maxSteps: 5,
      tools: { queryData } as ToolSet,
      onToken: (token: string) => {
        writer.write(encoder.encode(token));
      },
      onError: (error: { error: unknown; message?: string }) => {
        console.error('Stream error:', error);
        writer.write(encoder.encode(JSON.stringify({
          type: 'error',
          error: error.message || 'An error occurred during processing'
        })));
      },
      onFinish: async ({ response, reasoning }) => {
        if (session.user?.id) {
          try {
            const sanitizedResponseMessages = sanitizeResponseMessages({
              messages: response.messages,
              reasoning,
            });
            await saveMessages({
              messages: sanitizedResponseMessages.map((message) => ({
                id: message.id,
                chatId: id,
                role: message.role,
                content: message.content,
                createdAt: new Date(),
                ...(('data' in message) && { data: message.data }),
                ...(('visualization' in message) && { visualization: message.visualization }),
              })),
            });
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to save chat:', error);
          }
        }
        writer.close();
      },
    });

    return new Response(dataStream.readable, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
        'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-transform',
        'Connection': 'keep-alive',
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';

export function Layout({ children }) {

  );
}
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
export async function POST(request: Request) {

    // ... existing setup code ...
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/vote/route.ts
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const chatId = searchParams.get('chatId');

  if (!chatId) {
    return new Response('chatId is required', { status: 400 });
  }

  const session = await auth();

  if (!session || !session.user || !session.user.id) {
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const votes = await getVotesByChatId({ id: chatId });
    
    // Return empty array if no votes found instead of 404
    return Response.json(votes || [], { status: 200 });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get votes:', error);
    return new Response('Failed to get votes', { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
    // ... error handling
  }
}
```

Looking at the error and the Vercel AI SDK docs, we need to create the `dataStream` before we use it in the tools configuration. Let's move the `dataStream` creation before the `streamText` call:

```typescript:app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    // ... existing setup code ...

    const dataStream = new TransformStream();
    const writer = dataStream.writable.getWriter();

    // Create a DataStreamWriter for the tools
    const toolStream = {
      write: (data: any) => writer.write(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(data))),
      writeData: (data: any) => writer.write(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ type: 'data', data }))),
      writeMessageAnnotation: (data: any) => writer.write(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ type: 'annotation', data }))),
      writeSource: (data: any) => writer.write(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ type: 'source', data }))),
      close: () => writer.close(),
    };

    const stream = await streamText({
      model: provider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      system: systemMessage,
      messages,
      maxSteps: 5,
      tools: {
        getWeather,
        createDocument: createDocument({ session, dataStream: toolStream }),
        updateDocument: updateDocument({ session, dataStream: toolStream }),
        requestSuggestions: requestSuggestions({ session, dataStream: toolStream }),
        queryData,
      },
      onToken: (token: string) => {
        // Add logging to debug streaming
        console.log('Token received:', token);
        writer.write(new TextEncoder().encode(token));
      },
      onError: (error: { error: unknown; message?: string }) => {
        // Add more detailed error logging
        console.error('Stream error:', {
          error,
          model: selectedChatModel,
          messages: messages.length
        });
      },
      onFinish: async ({ response, reasoning }) => {
        // ... existing onFinish code ...
        writer.close();
      },
    });

    return new Response(dataStream.readable, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
        'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
        'Connection': 'keep-alive',
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // ... error handling
  }
}
```

Key changes:
1. Created `dataStream` and `writer` at the start
2. Created a `toolStream` object that implements the DataStreamWriter interface
3. Passed `toolStream` to the tools instead of raw `dataStream`

The issue was that we were passing the raw `TransformStream` to the tools, but they expect a `DataStreamWriter` interface with methods like `write`, `writeData`, etc. By creating a proper writer object that implements this interface, we should resolve the error.

This follows the pattern shown in the [Vercel AI SDK docs for tool usage](https://sdk.vercel.ai/docs/ai-sdk-ui/chatbot-tool-usage) and [tool calling](https://sdk.vercel.ai/docs/ai-sdk-core/tools-and-tool-calling).

```typescript:lib/ai/tools/query-data.ts
      });

        console.error('Query error:', error);
        throw error;
      }

      // Return early if no data
      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
        return {
          data: [],
          message: 'No data found'
        };
      }

      return {
        data,
        visualization,
        title,
        description,
        sql: query,
        message: 'Query executed successfully'
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Tool error:', error);
      throw new Error(`Query failed: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
});
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/chat/route.ts
import {
  type Message,
  createDataStreamResponse,
  streamText,
} from 'ai';
import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { getSystemPrompt } from '@/lib/ai/prompts';
import {
  deleteChatById,
  getChatById,
  saveChat,
  saveMessages,
} from '@/lib/db/queries';
import {
  generateUUID,
  getMostRecentUserMessage,
  sanitizeResponseMessages,
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { generateTitleFromUserMessage } from '../../actions';
import { createDocument } from '@/lib/ai/tools/create-document';
import { updateDocument } from '@/lib/ai/tools/update-document';
import { requestSuggestions } from '@/lib/ai/tools/request-suggestions';
import { getWeather } from '@/lib/ai/tools/get-weather';
import { myProvider } from '@/lib/ai/providers';
import { queryData } from '@/lib/ai/tools/query-data';
import { DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL } from '@/lib/ai/models';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const {
      id,
      messages,
      selectedChatModel = DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL,
    } = await request.json();

    const session = await auth();

    if (!session || !session.user || !session.user.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    const userMessage = getMostRecentUserMessage(messages);

    if (!userMessage) {
      return new Response('No user message found', { status: 400 });
    }

    // Save the chat if it doesn't exist
    const chat = await getChatById({ id });
    if (!chat) {
      const title = await generateTitleFromUserMessage({
        message: userMessage,
      });
      await saveChat({ id, userId: session.user.id, title });
    } else if (chat.userId !== session.user.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    // Save the user's message
    await saveMessages({
      messages: [{ ...userMessage, createdAt: new Date(), chatId: id }],
    });

    const systemMessage = await getSystemPrompt({
      selectedChatModel,
    });

    const stream = await streamText({
      model: myProvider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
      system: systemMessage,
      messages,
      maxSteps: 5,
      tools: {
        getWeather,
        createDocument: createDocument({ session }),
        updateDocument: updateDocument({ session }),
        requestSuggestions: requestSuggestions({ session }),
        queryData,
      },
      onFinish: async ({ response, reasoning }) => {
        if (session.user?.id) {
          try {
            const sanitizedResponseMessages = sanitizeResponseMessages({
              messages: response.messages,
              reasoning,
            });
            await saveMessages({
              messages: sanitizedResponseMessages.map((message) => ({
                id: generateUUID(),
                chatId: id,
                role: message.role,
                content: message.content,
                createdAt: new Date(),
              })),
            });
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to save chat:', error);
          }
        }
      },
    });

    return createDataStreamResponse(stream);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ 
        error: 'An error occurred during chat processing',
        details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      }), 
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!id) {
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  const session = await auth();

  if (!session || !session.user) {
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const chat = await getChatById({ id });

    if (chat.userId !== session.user.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    await deleteChatById({ id });

    return new Response('Chat deleted', { status: 200 });
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response('An error occurred while processing your request', {
      status: 500,
    });
  }
}
```

The error is coming from a hydration mismatch in the `AppSidebar` component, specifically with the logo image. The issue is that the server and client are rendering different versions of the logo based on the theme.

Let's fix this in `components/app-sidebar.tsx`:

```typescript:components/app-sidebar.tsx
'use client';

import type { User } from 'next-auth';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes';
// ... other imports

export function AppSidebar({ user }: { user: User | undefined }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();
  const { theme, systemTheme } = useTheme();

  // Determine which logo to use
  const currentTheme = theme === 'system' ? systemTheme : theme;
  const logoSrc = currentTheme === 'dark' 
    ? '/images/Hang-Logo-Short-W.png'
    : '/images/Hang-Logo-Short.png';

  return (
    <Sidebar className="group-data-[side=left]:border-r-0 border-r border-r-border/40 
      dark:bg-gradient-to-l dark:from-border/40 dark:via-background/20 dark:to-transparent 
      light:bg-gradient-to-l light:from-zinc-300/70 light:via-zinc-200/40 light:to-transparent 
      shadow-[2px_0_5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]">
      <SidebarHeader className="h-[60px] flex items-center">
        <SidebarMenu>
          <div className="flex flex-row justify-between items-center px-2">
            <Link
              href="/"
              onClick={() => {
                setOpenMobile(false);
              }}
              className="flex items-center"
            >
              <Image
                src={logoSrc}
                alt="Hang Logo"
                width={32}
                height={32}
                className="object-contain"
                priority
              />
            </Link>
            {/* ... rest of component */}
          </div>
        </SidebarMenu>
      </SidebarHeader>
      {/* ... rest of component */}
    </Sidebar>
  );
}
```

Key changes:
1. Added `systemTheme` from `useTheme()`
2. Added logic to determine the correct logo based on theme
3. Use a single `logoSrc` variable instead of conditional rendering

This should fix the hydration mismatch by ensuring the server and client render the same logo initially. The theme change will happen after hydration is complete.

```typescript:lib/db/queries.ts
  chatId,
  messageId,
  type,
}: {

  messageId: string;

}) {
  try {

      .select()
      .from(vote)
      .where(and(eq(vote.messageId, messageId)));

    if (existingVote) {
      return await db

    throw error;
  }
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/chat/route.ts
import {
  type Message,
  createDataStreamResponse,
  streamText,
} from 'ai';
import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { getSystemPrompt } from '@/lib/ai/prompts';
import {
  deleteChatById,
  getChatById,
  saveChat,
  saveMessages,
  getChatsByUserId,
  getVotesByChatId,
  voteMessage
} from '@/lib/db/queries';
import {
  generateUUID,
  getMostRecentUserMessage,
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { generateTitleFromUserMessage } from '../../actions';
import { myProvider } from '@/lib/ai/providers';

// Chat endpoint - POST /chat
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { id, messages } = await request.json();
    const session = await auth();

    if (!session?.user?.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    const userMessage = getMostRecentUserMessage(messages);
    if (!userMessage) {
      return new Response('No user message found', { status: 400 });
    }

    // Save chat and message
    const chat = await getChatById({ id });
    if (!chat) {
      const title = await generateTitleFromUserMessage({ message: userMessage });
      await saveChat({ id, userId: session.user.id, title });
    }

    await saveMessages({
      messages: [{ ...userMessage, createdAt: new Date(), chatId: id }],
    });

    const stream = await streamText({
      model: myProvider.languageModel('gpt-3.5-turbo'),
      system: await getSystemPrompt({}),
      messages,
      onFinish: async ({ messages: responseMessages }) => {
        await saveMessages({
          messages: responseMessages.map((message) => ({
            id: generateUUID(),
            chatId: id,
            role: message.role,
            content: message.content,
            createdAt: new Date(),
          })),
        });
      },
    });

    return createDataStreamResponse(stream);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return new Response('Error', { status: 500 });
  }
}

// Delete chat endpoint - DELETE /chat?id=xxx
export async function DELETE(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!id) {
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  const session = await auth();

  if (!session || !session.user) {
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const chat = await getChatById({ id });

    if (chat.userId !== session.user.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    await deleteChatById({ id });

    return new Response('Chat deleted', { status: 200 });
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response('An error occurred while processing your request', {
      status: 500,
    });
  }
}

// History endpoint - GET /chat
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const session = await auth();
  if (!session?.user?.id) {
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const chatId = searchParams.get('chatId');

  try {
    // If chatId is provided, return votes for that chat
    if (chatId) {
      const votes = await getVotesByChatId({ id: chatId });
      return Response.json(votes);
    }
    
    // Otherwise return chat history
    const chats = await getChatsByUserId({ userId: session.user.id });
    return Response.json(chats);
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response('Error', { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

This consolidates all chat-related endpoints into a single route handler, matching the structure of the working repository. Let me know if you want me to show any other changes!

```typescript:app/(chat)/chat/route.ts
import {
  type Message,
  createDataStreamResponse,
  streamText,
} from 'ai';
import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { getSystemPrompt } from '@/lib/ai/prompts';
import {
  deleteChatById,
  getChatById,
  saveChat,
  saveMessages,
  getChatsByUserId,
} from '@/lib/db/queries';
import {
  generateUUID,
  getMostRecentUserMessage,
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { generateTitleFromUserMessage } from '../actions';
import { myProvider } from '@/lib/ai/providers';

// Chat endpoint - POST /chat
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { id, messages } = await request.json();
    const session = await auth();

    if (!session?.user?.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    const userMessage = getMostRecentUserMessage(messages);
    if (!userMessage) {
      return new Response('No user message found', { status: 400 });
    }

    // Save chat and message
    const chat = await getChatById({ id });
    if (!chat) {
      const title = await generateTitleFromUserMessage({ message: userMessage });
      await saveChat({ id, userId: session.user.id, title });
    }

    await saveMessages({
      messages: [{ ...userMessage, createdAt: new Date(), chatId: id }],
    });

    const stream = await streamText({
      model: myProvider.languageModel('gpt-3.5-turbo'),
      system: await getSystemPrompt({}),
      messages,
      onFinish: async ({ messages: responseMessages }) => {
        if (!responseMessages?.length) return;
        
        await saveMessages({
          messages: responseMessages.map((message) => ({
            id: generateUUID(),
            chatId: id,
            role: message.role,
            content: message.content,
            createdAt: new Date(),
          })),
        });
      },
    });

    return createDataStreamResponse(stream);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return new Response('Error', { status: 500 });
  }
}

// History endpoint - GET /chat
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const session = await auth();
  if (!session?.user?.id) {
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const chats = await getChatsByUserId({ userId: session.user.id });
    return Response.json(chats);
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response('Error', { status: 500 });
  }
}

// Delete chat endpoint - DELETE /chat?id=xxx
export async function DELETE(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!id) {
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  const session = await auth();

  if (!session || !session.user) {
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const chat = await getChatById({ id });

    if (chat.userId !== session.user.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    await deleteChatById({ id });

    return new Response('Chat deleted', { status: 200 });
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response('An error occurred while processing your request', {
      status: 500,
    });
  }
}
```

Key changes:
1. Removed all extra API routes
2. Consolidated all chat functionality into one route file
3. Simplified the implementation to match the working version
4. Removed tools and extra providers that were causing issues

Let me know if you want me to show any other changes needed!

```typescript:app/(chat)/chat/route.ts
import {
  type Message,
  createDataStreamResponse,
  streamText,
} from 'ai';
import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { getSystemPrompt } from '@/lib/ai/prompts';
import {
  deleteChatById,
  getChatById,
  saveChat,
  saveMessages,
  getChatsByUserId,
} from '@/lib/db/queries';
import {
  generateUUID,
  getMostRecentUserMessage,
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { generateTitleFromUserMessage } from '../actions';
import { myProvider } from '@/lib/ai/providers';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { id, messages, selectedChatModel } = await request.json();
    const session = await auth();

    if (!session?.user?.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    const userMessage = getMostRecentUserMessage(messages);
    if (!userMessage) {
      return new Response('No user message found', { status: 400 });
    }

    // Save chat and message
    const chat = await getChatById({ id });
    if (!chat) {
      const title = await generateTitleFromUserMessage({ message: userMessage });
      await saveChat({ 
        id, 
        userId: session.user.id, 
        title,
        visibility: 'private'  // Add this line
      });
    }

    await saveMessages({
      messages: [{ 
        ...userMessage, 
        createdAt: new Date(), 
        chatId: id,
        id: generateUUID(),  // Add this line
      }],
    });

    const stream = await streamText({
      model: myProvider.languageModel('gpt-3.5-turbo'),
      system: await getSystemPrompt({}),
      messages,
      onFinish: async ({ messages: responseMessages }) => {
        if (!responseMessages?.length) return;
        
        await saveMessages({
          messages: responseMessages.map((message) => ({
            id: generateUUID(),
            chatId: id,
            role: message.role,
            content: message.content,
            createdAt: new Date(),
          })),
        });
      },
    });

    return createDataStreamResponse(stream);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ 
      error: 'An error occurred during chat processing',
      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    }), { 
      status: 500,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript:app/(chat)/chat/route.ts
export async function POST(request: Request) {

    const { id, messages, selectedChatModel } = await request.json();

      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    const userMessage = getMostRecentUserMessage(messages);
    if (!userMessage) {
      return new Response('No user message found', { status: 400 });

      if (!chat) {
        const title = await generateTitleFromUserMessage({ message: userMessage });
        await saveChat({ 
          id, 
          userId: session.user.id, 
          title,
          visibility: 'private'
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Chat save error:', error);
      throw error;
    }

        messages: [{

          createdAt: new Date(), 
          chatId: id,
          id: generateUUID(),
        }],
      });

      console.error('Message save error:', error);
      throw error;
    }

        model: myProvider.languageModel('gpt-3.5-turbo'),
        system: await getSystemPrompt({}),
        messages,
        onFinish: async ({ messages: responseMessages }) => {
          if (!responseMessages?.length) return;
          
          await saveMessages({
            messages: responseMessages.map((message) => ({
              id: generateUUID(),
              chatId: id,
              role: message.role,
              content: message.content,
              createdAt: new Date(),
            })),
          });
        },
      });

      return createDataStreamResponse(stream);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Stream error:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({

      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    }), { 
      status: 500,
      headers: {

    });
  }
}
```

```typescript:lib/db/schema.ts
});
```

```typescript:lib/db/queries.ts
export async function saveMessages({ messages }: { messages: Array<Message> }) {
  try {
    return await db.insert(message).values(messages.map(msg => ({
      id: msg.id,
      chatId: msg.chatId,
      role: msg.role,
      content: typeof msg.content === 'string' ? { text: msg.content } : msg.content,
      createdAt: msg.createdAt,
    })));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to save messages:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

import {
  type Message,
  createDataStreamResponse,
  smoothStream,
  streamText,
} from 'ai';
import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { systemPrompt } from '@/lib/ai/prompts';
import {
  deleteChatById,
  getChatById,
  saveChat,
  saveMessages,
} from '@/lib/db/queries';
import {
  generateUUID,
  getMostRecentUserMessage,
  sanitizeResponseMessages,
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { generateTitleFromUserMessage } from '../../actions';
import { createDocument } from '@/lib/ai/tools/create-document';
import { updateDocument } from '@/lib/ai/tools/update-document';
import { requestSuggestions } from '@/lib/ai/tools/request-suggestions';
import { getWeather } from '@/lib/ai/tools/get-weather';
import { isProductionEnvironment } from '@/lib/constants';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { myProvider } from '@/lib/ai/providers';

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const {
      id,
      messages,
      selectedChatModel,
    }: {
      id: string;
      messages: Array<Message>;
      selectedChatModel: string;
    } = await request.json();

    const session = await auth();

    if (!session || !session.user || !session.user.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    const userMessage = getMostRecentUserMessage(messages);

    if (!userMessage) {
      return new Response('No user message found', { status: 400 });
    }

    const chat = await getChatById({ id });

    if (!chat) {
      const title = await generateTitleFromUserMessage({
        message: userMessage,
      });

      await saveChat({ id, userId: session.user.id, title });
    } else {
      if (chat.userId !== session.user.id) {
        return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
      }
    }

    await saveMessages({
      messages: [{ ...userMessage, createdAt: new Date(), chatId: id }],
    });

    return createDataStreamResponse({
      execute: (dataStream) => {
        const result = streamText({
          model: myProvider.languageModel(selectedChatModel),
          system: systemPrompt({ selectedChatModel }),
          messages,
          maxSteps: 5,
          experimental_activeTools:
            selectedChatModel === 'chat-model-reasoning'
              ? []
              : [
                  'getWeather',
                  'createDocument',
                  'updateDocument',
                  'requestSuggestions',
                ],
          experimental_transform: smoothStream({ chunking: 'word' }),
          experimental_generateMessageId: generateUUID,
          tools: {
            getWeather,
            createDocument: createDocument({ session, dataStream }),
            updateDocument: updateDocument({ session, dataStream }),
            requestSuggestions: requestSuggestions({
              session,
              dataStream,
            }),
          },
          onFinish: async ({ response, reasoning }) => {
            if (session.user?.id) {
              try {
                const sanitizedResponseMessages = sanitizeResponseMessages({
                  messages: response.messages,
                  reasoning,
                });

                await saveMessages({
                  messages: sanitizedResponseMessages.map((message) => {
                    return {
                      id: message.id,
                      chatId: id,
                      role: message.role,
                      content: message.content,
                      createdAt: new Date(),
                    };
                  }),
                });
              } catch (error) {
                console.error('Failed to save chat');
              }
            }
          },
          experimental_telemetry: {
            isEnabled: isProductionEnvironment,
            functionId: 'stream-text',
          },
        });

        result.consumeStream();

        result.mergeIntoDataStream(dataStream, {
          sendReasoning: true,
        });
      },
      onError: () => {
        return 'Oops, an error occured!';
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error }, { status: 400 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!id) {
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  const session = await auth();

  if (!session || !session.user) {
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const chat = await getChatById({ id });

    if (chat.userId !== session.user.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    await deleteChatById({ id });

    return new Response('Chat deleted', { status: 200 });
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response('An error occurred while processing your request', {
      status: 500,
    });
  }
}

```typescript:app/(chat)/chat/route.ts
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { id, messages, selectedChatModel } = await request.json();
    const session = await auth();

    if (!session?.user?.id) {
      return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
    }

    const userMessage = getMostRecentUserMessage(messages);
    if (!userMessage) {
      return new Response('No user message found', { status: 400 });
    }

    const chat = await getChatById({ id });
    if (!chat) {
      const title = await generateTitleFromUserMessage({ message: userMessage });
      await saveChat({ 
        id, 
        userId: session.user.id, 
        title,
        visibility: 'private'
      });
    }

    await saveMessages({
      messages: [{ 
        ...userMessage, 
        createdAt: new Date(), 
        chatId: id,
        id: generateUUID(),
      }],
    });

    return createDataStreamResponse({
      execute: (dataStream) => {
        const result = streamText({
          model: myProvider.languageModel('gpt-3.5-turbo'),
          system: systemPrompt({}),
          messages,
          experimental_transform: smoothStream({ chunking: 'word' }),
          experimental_generateMessageId: generateUUID,
          onFinish: async ({ response, reasoning }) => {
            if (session.user?.id) {
              try {
                const sanitizedResponseMessages = sanitizeResponseMessages({
                  messages: response.messages,
                  reasoning,
                });

                await saveMessages({
                  messages: sanitizedResponseMessages.map((message) => ({
                    id: message.id,
                    chatId: id,
                    role: message.role,
                    content: message.content,
                    createdAt: new Date(),
                  })),
                });
              } catch (error) {
                console.error('Failed to save chat');
              }
            }
          },
        });

        result.consumeStream();
        result.mergeIntoDataStream(dataStream, {
          sendReasoning: true,
        });
      },
      onError: () => {
        return 'Oops, an error occurred!';
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ 
      error: 'An error occurred during chat processing',
      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    }), { 
      status: 500,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    });
  }
}
```

## 1. Database Schema and Message Saving Mismatch

The error message indicates there's still a mismatch between what's being saved and your database schema:

```
Failed to save messages: [Error [PostgresError]: column "data" of relation "Message" does not exist]
```
