# Adding React Query Provider

This error occurs because you're using React Query hooks without setting up a QueryClientProvider at a higher level in your component tree. Let's create a provider and integrate it into your app layout:

```typescript:lib/providers.tsx
'use client'

import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { ReactQueryDevtools } from '@tanstack/react-query-devtools'
import { useState, ReactNode } from 'react'

export function Providers({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  // Create a client for each request in client components
  const [queryClient] = useState(
    () =>
      new QueryClient({
        defaultOptions: {
          queries: {
            staleTime: 60 * 1000, // 1 minute
            refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
          },
        },
      })
  )

  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      {children}
      {process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && <ReactQueryDevtools />}
    </QueryClientProvider>
  )
}
```

Now, let's update your app's root layout to use this provider:

```typescript:app/layout.tsx
import '@/app/globals.css'
import { Inter as FontSans } from 'next/font/google'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { TailwindIndicator } from '@/components/tailwind-indicator'
import { ThemeProvider } from '@/components/theme-provider'
import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/toaster'
import { siteConfig } from '@/config/site'
import { Providers } from '@/lib/providers'

const fontSans = FontSans({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  variable: '--font-sans',
})

interface RootLayoutProps {
  children: React.ReactNode
}

export const metadata = {
  title: 'AI Chat App',
  description: 'An AI chat application'
}

export const viewport = {
  themeColor: '#000000' // Move theme color here from metadata
}

export default function RootLayout({ children }: RootLayoutProps) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head />
      <body
        className={cn(
          'min-h-screen bg-background font-sans antialiased',
          fontSans.variable
        )}
      >
        <Providers>
          <ThemeProvider
            attribute="class"
            defaultTheme="system"
            enableSystem
            disableTransitionOnChange
          >
            {children}
            <Toaster />
            <TailwindIndicator />
          </ThemeProvider>
        </Providers>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

These changes add the React Query provider at the application's root level, which will make the `useQuery` hook available throughout your application, including in the ChatList component.

Also, I've fixed the theme color warning by moving it to the `viewport` export instead of the `metadata` export as per Next.js's recommendation.

'use client'

import * as React from 'react'
import Textarea from 'react-textarea-autosize'

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { IconArrowElbow } from '@/components/ui/icons'
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipTrigger
} from '@/components/ui/tooltip'
import { useEnterSubmit } from '@/lib/hooks/use-enter-submit'

export interface PromptProps {
  input: string
  setInput: (value: string) => void
  isLoading: boolean
  onSubmit: (value: string) => Promise<void>
  inputRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement>
}

export const PromptForm = React.forwardRef<HTMLFormElement, PromptProps>(
  ({ input, setInput, isLoading, onSubmit, inputRef: externalInputRef }, ref) => {
    const { formRef, onKeyDown } = useEnterSubmit()
    const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null)
    const actualInputRef = externalInputRef || inputRef

    // Connect our internal formRef with the forwarded ref
    React.useImperativeHandle(ref, () => formRef.current as HTMLFormElement)

    return (
      <form
        ref={formRef}
        onSubmit={async e => {
          e.preventDefault()
          if (!input?.trim()) {
            return
          }
          setInput('')
          await onSubmit(input)
        }}
        className="relative flex max-h-60 w-full grow flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background sm:rounded-md sm:border sm:px-4 sm:py-2.5"
      >
        <Textarea
          ref={actualInputRef}
          tabIndex={0}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          rows={1}
          placeholder="Send a message."
          className="min-h-[60px] w-full resize-none bg-transparent px-4 py-[1.3rem] focus-within:outline-none sm:text-sm"
          value={input}
          onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
        />
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-4 sm:right-4">
          <Tooltip>
            <TooltipTrigger asChild>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                size="icon"
                disabled={isLoading || input === ''}
              >
                <IconArrowElbow />
                <span className="sr-only">Send message</span>
              </Button>
            </TooltipTrigger>
            <TooltipContent>Send message</TooltipContent>
          </Tooltip>
        </div>
      </form>
    )
  }
)
PromptForm.displayName = 'PromptForm'
```

In this fix, I'm:

2. Ensuring the actual HTML form element is correctly referenced
3. Properly handling the inputRef (adding an optional external inputRef parameter)

This should fix the issue with `formRef.current.reset()` not being a function by ensuring that `formRef.current` is actually a proper HTML form element that has a reset method.

'use client'

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'

import { getChats } from '@/lib/actions/chat'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { ChatHistory } from '@/components/chat-history'
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton'
import { IconMessage, IconUsers } from '@/components/ui/icons'

export interface SidebarHistoryProps {
  userId?: string
}

export function SidebarHistory({ userId }: SidebarHistoryProps) {
  const router = useRouter()

  // Use React Query to fetch chats
  const { data: chats, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['chats'],
    queryFn: () => getChats(),
    enabled: !!userId // Only fetch if there's a userId
  })

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
      <div className="px-2 my-4">
        <Link
          href="/"
          className={cn(
            'flex items-center px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:text-foreground text-muted-foreground'
          )}
        >
          <IconMessage className="mr-2" />
          <span className="ml-1">New Chat</span>
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          {isLoading ? (
            <motion.div
              key="loading"
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              className="space-y-2 px-2 py-1"
            >
              {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
                <Skeleton key={i} className="h-7" />
              ))}
            </motion.div>
          ) : error ? (
            <motion.div
              key="error"
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              className="p-4 text-sm text-center text-muted-foreground"
            >
              <p>Failed to load chat history</p>
              <button 
                className="underline mt-2" 
                onClick={() => router.refresh()}
              >
                Try again
              </button>
            </motion.div>
          ) : (
            <ChatHistory chats={chats || []} />
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

1. Uses React Query's `useQuery` hook to fetch the chat history, with appropriate loading and error states
2. Adds a loading skeleton instead of just text
3. Provides an error state with a refresh option
4. Only attempts to fetch if there's a userId
5. Uses AnimatePresence from Framer Motion for smooth transitions between states

This should fix the error you're seeing and provide a better user experience with loading states and error handling.

# Fix for SidebarHistory Component

```typescript:components/sidebar-history.tsx
'use client'

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useRouter, useParams } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { getChats, removeChat } from '@/lib/actions/chat'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { IconMessage, IconSpinner, IconTrash } from '@/components/ui/icons'
import { 
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog'

export function SidebarHistory() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const params = useParams()
  const id = params?.id as string
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [showDeleteDialog, setShowDeleteDialog] = useState(false)

  // Use React Query to fetch chats
  const { data: chats, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['chats'],
    queryFn: () => getChats(),
  })

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteId) return
    try {
      await removeChat(deleteId)
      if (deleteId === id) {
        router.push('/chat')
      }
      refetch() // Refresh the chat list
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete chat:', error)
    } finally {
      setDeleteId(null)
      setShowDeleteDialog(false)
    }
  }

  // Group chats by date
  const groupedChats = chats ? {
    today: chats.filter(chat => {
      const date = new Date(chat.createdAt)
      const today = new Date()
      return date.toDateString() === today.toDateString()
    }),
    yesterday: chats.filter(chat => {
      const date = new Date(chat.createdAt)
      const yesterday = new Date()
      yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1)
      return date.toDateString() === yesterday.toDateString()
    }),
    earlier: chats.filter(chat => {
      const date = new Date(chat.createdAt)
      const yesterday = new Date()
      yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1)
      return date.toDateString() !== yesterday.toDateString() && 
             date.toDateString() !== new Date().toDateString()
    }),
  } : { today: [], yesterday: [], earlier: [] }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="p-4 text-center">
            <IconSpinner className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 mx-auto mb-2" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading chats...</p>
          </div>
        ) : chats?.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No chat history</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 p-2">
            {groupedChats.today.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Today
                </div>
                {groupedChats.today.map(chat => (
                  <div key={chat.id} className="relative group">
                    <Link
                      href={`/chat/${chat.id}`}
                      className={cn(
                        "flex items-center px-2 py-1.5 text-sm rounded-md hover:bg-accent",
                        chat.id === id && "bg-accent"
                      )}
                    >
                      <IconMessage className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                      <span className="truncate">{chat.title || "New Chat"}</span>
                    </Link>
                    <div className="absolute right-1 top-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-6 w-6"
                        onClick={e => {
                          e.preventDefault()
                          e.stopPropagation()
                          setDeleteId(chat.id)
                          setShowDeleteDialog(true)
                        }}
                      >
                        <IconTrash className="h-4 w-4" />
                        <span className="sr-only">Delete</span>
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </>
            )}

            {groupedChats.yesterday.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-4">
                  Yesterday
                </div>
                {groupedChats.yesterday.map(chat => (
                  <div key={chat.id} className="relative group">
                    <Link
                      href={`/chat/${chat.id}`}
                      className={cn(
                        "flex items-center px-2 py-1.5 text-sm rounded-md hover:bg-accent",
                        chat.id === id && "bg-accent"
                      )}
                    >
                      <IconMessage className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                      <span className="truncate">{chat.title || "New Chat"}</span>
                    </Link>
                    <div className="absolute right-1 top-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-6 w-6"
                        onClick={e => {
                          e.preventDefault()
                          e.stopPropagation()
                          setDeleteId(chat.id)
                          setShowDeleteDialog(true)
                        }}
                      >
                        <IconTrash className="h-4 w-4" />
                        <span className="sr-only">Delete</span>
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </>
            )}

            {groupedChats.earlier.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-4">
                  Earlier
                </div>
                {groupedChats.earlier.map(chat => (
                  <div key={chat.id} className="relative group">
                    <Link
                      href={`/chat/${chat.id}`}
                      className={cn(
                        "flex items-center px-2 py-1.5 text-sm rounded-md hover:bg-accent",
                        chat.id === id && "bg-accent"
                      )}
                    >
                      <IconMessage className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                      <span className="truncate">{chat.title || "New Chat"}</span>
                    </Link>
                    <div className="absolute right-1 top-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-6 w-6"
                        onClick={e => {
                          e.preventDefault()
                          e.stopPropagation()
                          setDeleteId(chat.id)
                          setShowDeleteDialog(true)
                        }}
                      >
                        <IconTrash className="h-4 w-4" />
                        <span className="sr-only">Delete</span>
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <AlertDialog open={showDeleteDialog} onOpenChange={setShowDeleteDialog}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Chat</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your
              chat and remove it from our servers.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete}>
              Delete
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export function ChatList() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [isRemovingId, setIsRemovingId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const { data: chats, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['chats'],
    queryFn: () => getChats()
  })

  const removeItem = async (id: string) => {
    setIsRemovingId(id)

      await removeChat(id)

  return (

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <IconSpinner className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />

      ) : chats?.length === 0 ? (

              <Tooltip>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"

                    onClick={e => {

                      e.stopPropagation()
                      removeItem(chat.id)

'use client'

import { isToday, isYesterday, subMonths, subWeeks } from 'date-fns'
import Link from 'next/link'

import type { User } from 'next-auth'

import {

  SidebarGroupTitle,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuItem,
} from '@/components/ui/sidebar'
import { getChats, removeChat } from '@/lib/actions/chat'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function SidebarHistory({ setOpenMobile }: { setOpenMobile?: (open: boolean) => void }) {
  const params = useParams()
  const { id } = params
  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [showDeleteDialog, setShowDeleteDialog] = useState(false)

  const { data: chats, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['chats'],
    queryFn: () => getChats()
  })

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteId) return
    
    try {
      await removeChat(deleteId)
      toast.success('Chat deleted')
      
      if (deleteId === id) {
        router.push('/')
      }
      
      refetch()
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete chat')
    } finally {
      setDeleteId(null)
      setShowDeleteDialog(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <SidebarGroup className="border-none pb-0">
        <SidebarGroupContent>
          <SidebarMenu>
            {(() => {
              if (isLoading) {
                return (
                  <div className="p-4 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                    Loading chats...
                  </div>
                )
              }

              if (!chats?.length) {
                return (
                  <div className="p-4 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                    No chats yet
                  </div>
                )
              }

              // Group chats by date
              const today = chats.filter(chat => {
                const date = new Date(chat.createdAt)
                return isToday(date)
              })

              const yesterday = chats.filter(chat => {
                const date = new Date(chat.createdAt)
                return isYesterday(date)
              })

              const lastWeek = chats.filter(chat => {
                const date = new Date(chat.createdAt)
                const weekAgo = subWeeks(new Date(), 1)
                return date > weekAgo && !isToday(date) && !isYesterday(date)
              })

              const older = chats.filter(chat => {
                const date = new Date(chat.createdAt)
                const weekAgo = subWeeks(new Date(), 1)
                return date <= weekAgo
              })

              const groupedChats = {
                today,
                yesterday,
                lastWeek,
                older
              }

                  {groupedChats.yesterday.length > 0 && (

                            key={chat.id}
                            chat={chat}
                            isActive={chat.id === id}
                            onDelete={(chatId) => {
                              setDeleteId(chatId)
                              setShowDeleteDialog(true)
                            }}
                            setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </>

                  {groupedChats.lastWeek.length > 0 && (
                    <>
                      <div className="mb-2 px-2 pt-2">
                        <div className="mb-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          Previous 7 Days
                        </div>
                        {groupedChats.lastWeek.map(chat => (
                          <ChatItem
                            key={chat.id}
                            chat={chat}
                            isActive={chat.id === id}
                            onDelete={(chatId) => {
                              setDeleteId(chatId)
                              setShowDeleteDialog(true)
                            }}
                            setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {groupedChats.older.length > 0 && (
                    <>
                      <div className="mb-2 px-2 pt-2">
                        <div className="mb-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          Older
                        </div>
                        {groupedChats.older.map(chat => (
                          <ChatItem
                            key={chat.id}
                            chat={chat}
                            isActive={chat.id === id}
                            onDelete={(chatId) => {
                              setDeleteId(chatId)
                              setShowDeleteDialog(true)
                            }}
                            setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </>
              )
            })()}
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarGroupContent>
      </SidebarGroup>
      <AlertDialog open={showDeleteDialog} onOpenChange={setShowDeleteDialog}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Chat</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your
              chat and remove it from our servers.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete}>
              Delete
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  )
}

function ChatItem({
  chat,
  isActive,
  onDelete,
  setOpenMobile
}: {
  chat: any
  isActive: boolean
  onDelete: (chatId: string) => void
  setOpenMobile?: (open: boolean) => void
}) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={`/chat/${chat.id}`}
      onClick={() => setOpenMobile?.(false)}
      className={cn(
        'flex items-center px-2 py-1.5 text-sm rounded-md hover:bg-accent group relative',
        isActive && 'bg-accent'
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
        <div className="flex-1 truncate">{chat.title || 'New Chat'}</div>
        <div className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="ghost" className="h-6 w-6 p-0">
                <MoreHorizontalIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>
              </Button>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
              <DropdownMenuItem onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault()
                e.stopPropagation()
                onDelete(chat.id)
              }}>
                <TrashIcon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                Delete chat
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Link>
  )
}
```

This implementation closely mirrors the Vercel AI Chatbot's structure:

1. It uses React Query for data fetching with proper loading states
2. It groups chats by date (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 Days, Older)
3. It includes a ChatItem component for individual chat items
4. It provides a deletion confirmation dialog
5. It handles mobile navigation properly

The component now more closely follows the structure from the repository you referenced. Note that if any UI components like `SidebarGroup` or others are missing, you may need to create them or adjust the implementation to match your existing component library.

'use client';

import { isToday, isYesterday, subMonths, subWeeks } from 'date-fns';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams, usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import type { User } from 'next-auth';
import { memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import useSWR from 'swr';

import {
  CheckCircleFillIcon,
  GlobeIcon,
  LockIcon,
  MoreHorizontalIcon,
  ShareIcon,
  TrashIcon,
} from '@/components/icons';
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuPortal,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import {
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuAction,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  useSidebar,
} from '@/components/ui/sidebar';
import type { Chat } from '@/lib/db/schema';
import { fetcher } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useChatVisibility } from '@/hooks/use-chat-visibility';

type GroupedChats = {
  today: Chat[];
  yesterday: Chat[];
  lastWeek: Chat[];
  lastMonth: Chat[];
  older: Chat[];
};

const PureChatItem = ({
  chat,
  isActive,
  onDelete,
  setOpenMobile,
}: {
  chat: Chat;
  isActive: boolean;
  onDelete: (chatId: string) => void;
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void;
}) => {
  const { visibilityType, setVisibilityType } = useChatVisibility({
    chatId: chat.id,
    initialVisibility: chat.visibility,
  });

  return (
    <SidebarMenuItem>
      <SidebarMenuButton asChild isActive={isActive}>
        <Link href={`/chat/${chat.id}`} onClick={() => setOpenMobile(false)}>
          <span>{chat.title}</span>
        </Link>
      </SidebarMenuButton>

      <DropdownMenu modal={true}>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
          <SidebarMenuAction
            className="data-[state=open]:bg-sidebar-accent data-[state=open]:text-sidebar-accent-foreground mr-0.5"
            showOnHover={!isActive}
          >
            <MoreHorizontalIcon />
            <span className="sr-only">More</span>
          </SidebarMenuAction>
        </DropdownMenuTrigger>

        <DropdownMenuContent side="bottom" align="end">
          <DropdownMenuSub>
            <DropdownMenuSubTrigger className="cursor-pointer">
              <ShareIcon />
              <span>Share</span>
            </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuPortal>
              <DropdownMenuSubContent>
                <DropdownMenuItem
                  className="cursor-pointer flex-row justify-between"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setVisibilityType('private');
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-row gap-2 items-center">
                    <LockIcon size={12} />
                    <span>Private</span>
                  </div>
                  {visibilityType === 'private' ? (
                    <CheckCircleFillIcon />
                  ) : null}
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem
                  className="cursor-pointer flex-row justify-between"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setVisibilityType('public');
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-row gap-2 items-center">
                    <GlobeIcon />
                    <span>Public</span>
                  </div>
                  {visibilityType === 'public' ? <CheckCircleFillIcon /> : null}
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuSubContent>
            </DropdownMenuPortal>
          </DropdownMenuSub>

          <DropdownMenuItem
            className="cursor-pointer text-destructive focus:bg-destructive/15 focus:text-destructive dark:text-red-500"
            onSelect={() => onDelete(chat.id)}
          >
            <TrashIcon />
            <span>Delete</span>
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>
    </SidebarMenuItem>
  );
};

export const ChatItem = memo(PureChatItem, (prevProps, nextProps) => {
  if (prevProps.isActive !== nextProps.isActive) return false;
  return true;
});

export function SidebarHistory({ user }: { user: User | undefined }) {
  const { setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();
  const { id } = useParams();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const {
    data: history,
    isLoading,
    mutate,
  } = useSWR<Array<Chat>>(user ? '/api/history' : null, fetcher, {
    fallbackData: [],
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    mutate();
  }, [pathname, mutate]);

  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showDeleteDialog, setShowDeleteDialog] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const handleDelete = async () => {
    const deletePromise = fetch(`/api/chat?id=${deleteId}`, {
      method: 'DELETE',
    });

    toast.promise(deletePromise, {
      loading: 'Deleting chat...',
      success: () => {
        mutate((history) => {
          if (history) {
            return history.filter((h) => h.id !== id);
          }
        });
        return 'Chat deleted successfully';
      },
      error: 'Failed to delete chat',
    });

    setShowDeleteDialog(false);

    if (deleteId === id) {
      router.push('/');
    }
  };

  if (!user) {
    return (
      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarGroupContent>
          <div className="px-2 text-zinc-500 w-full flex flex-row justify-center items-center text-sm gap-2">
            Login to save and revisit previous chats!
          </div>
        </SidebarGroupContent>
      </SidebarGroup>
    );
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <SidebarGroup>
        <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/50">
          Today
        </div>
        <SidebarGroupContent>
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            {[44, 32, 28, 64, 52].map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item}
                className="rounded-md h-8 flex gap-2 px-2 items-center"
              >
                <div
                  className="h-4 rounded-md flex-1 max-w-[--skeleton-width] bg-sidebar-accent-foreground/10"
                  style={
                    {
                      '--skeleton-width': `${item}%`,
                    } as React.CSSProperties
                  }
                />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </SidebarGroupContent>
      </SidebarGroup>
    );
  }

  if (history?.length === 0) {
    return (
      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarGroupContent>
          <div className="px-2 text-zinc-500 w-full flex flex-row justify-center items-center text-sm gap-2">
            Your conversations will appear here once you start chatting!
          </div>
        </SidebarGroupContent>
      </SidebarGroup>
    );
  }

  const groupChatsByDate = (chats: Chat[]): GroupedChats => {
    const now = new Date();
    const oneWeekAgo = subWeeks(now, 1);
    const oneMonthAgo = subMonths(now, 1);

    return chats.reduce(
      (groups, chat) => {
        const chatDate = new Date(chat.createdAt);

        if (isToday(chatDate)) {
          groups.today.push(chat);
        } else if (isYesterday(chatDate)) {
          groups.yesterday.push(chat);
        } else if (chatDate > oneWeekAgo) {
          groups.lastWeek.push(chat);
        } else if (chatDate > oneMonthAgo) {
          groups.lastMonth.push(chat);
        } else {
          groups.older.push(chat);
        }

        return groups;
      },
      {
        today: [],
        yesterday: [],
        lastWeek: [],
        lastMonth: [],
        older: [],
      } as GroupedChats,
    );
  };

  return (
    <>
      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarGroupContent>
          <SidebarMenu>
            {history &&
              (() => {
                const groupedChats = groupChatsByDate(history);

                return (
                  <>
                    {groupedChats.today.length > 0 && (
                      <>
                        <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/50">
                          Today
                        </div>
                        {groupedChats.today.map((chat) => (
                          <ChatItem
                            key={chat.id}
                            chat={chat}
                            isActive={chat.id === id}
                            onDelete={(chatId) => {
                              setDeleteId(chatId);
                              setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                            }}
                            setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </>
                    )}

                    {groupedChats.yesterday.length > 0 && (
                      <>
                        <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/50 mt-6">
                          Yesterday
                        </div>
                        {groupedChats.yesterday.map((chat) => (
                          <ChatItem
                            key={chat.id}
                            chat={chat}
                            isActive={chat.id === id}
                            onDelete={(chatId) => {
                              setDeleteId(chatId);
                              setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                            }}
                            setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </>
                    )}

                    {groupedChats.lastWeek.length > 0 && (
                      <>
                        <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/50 mt-6">
                          Last 7 days
                        </div>
                        {groupedChats.lastWeek.map((chat) => (
                          <ChatItem
                            key={chat.id}
                            chat={chat}
                            isActive={chat.id === id}
                            onDelete={(chatId) => {
                              setDeleteId(chatId);
                              setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                            }}
                            setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </>
                    )}

                    {groupedChats.lastMonth.length > 0 && (
                      <>
                        <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/50 mt-6">
                          Last 30 days
                        </div>
                        {groupedChats.lastMonth.map((chat) => (
                          <ChatItem
                            key={chat.id}
                            chat={chat}
                            isActive={chat.id === id}
                            onDelete={(chatId) => {
                              setDeleteId(chatId);
                              setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                            }}
                            setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </>
                    )}

                    {groupedChats.older.length > 0 && (
                      <>
                        <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/50 mt-6">
                          Older
                        </div>
                        {groupedChats.older.map((chat) => (
                          <ChatItem
                            key={chat.id}
                            chat={chat}
                            isActive={chat.id === id}
                            onDelete={(chatId) => {
                              setDeleteId(chatId);
                              setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                            }}
                            setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </>
                    )}
                  </>
                );
              })()}
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarGroupContent>
      </SidebarGroup>
      <AlertDialog open={showDeleteDialog} onOpenChange={setShowDeleteDialog}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Are you absolutely sure?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your
              chat and remove it from our servers.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete}>
              Continue
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  );
}

import { auth } from '@/app/(auth)/auth';
import { getChatsByUserId } from '@/lib/db/queries';

export async function GET() {
  const session = await auth();

  if (!session || !session.user) {
    return Response.json('Unauthorized!', { status: 401 });
  }

  // biome-ignore lint: Forbidden non-null assertion.
  const chats = await getChatsByUserId({ id: session.user.id! });
  return Response.json(chats);
}

# Let's Implement SidebarHistory Similar to Vercel's AI Chatbot

Based on the code you shared from the Vercel implementation, I'll create a `sidebar-history.tsx` component that follows their approach but uses your existing infrastructure (React Query instead of SWR):

```typescript:components/sidebar-history.tsx
'use client';

import { isToday, isYesterday, subMonths, subWeeks } from 'date-fns';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams, usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { memo, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  IconMessage,
  IconTrash,
  IconMoreHorizontal,
} from '@/components/ui/icons';
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { getChats, removeChat } from '@/lib/actions/chat';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function SidebarHistory({ setOpenMobile }: { setOpenMobile?: (open: boolean) => void }) {
  const params = useParams();
  const { id } = params;
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showDeleteDialog, setShowDeleteDialog] = useState(false);

  // Use React Query to fetch chats
  const { data: chats, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['chats'],
    queryFn: () => getChats()
  });

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    
    try {
      await removeChat(deleteId);
      toast.success('Chat deleted');
      
      if (deleteId === id) {
        router.push('/');
      }
      
      refetch();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete chat');
    } finally {
      setDeleteId(null);
      setShowDeleteDialog(false);
    }
  };

  // Group chats by date
  const groupChatsByDate = (chatList) => {
    if (!chatList) return { today: [], yesterday: [], lastWeek: [], lastMonth: [], older: [] };
    
    const now = new Date();
    const oneWeekAgo = subWeeks(now, 1);
    const oneMonthAgo = subMonths(now, 1);

    return chatList.reduce(
      (groups, chat) => {
        const chatDate = new Date(chat.createdAt);

        if (isToday(chatDate)) {
          groups.today.push(chat);
        } else if (isYesterday(chatDate)) {
          groups.yesterday.push(chat);
        } else if (chatDate > oneWeekAgo) {
          groups.lastWeek.push(chat);
        } else if (chatDate > oneMonthAgo) {
          groups.lastMonth.push(chat);
        } else {
          groups.older.push(chat);
        }

        return groups;
      },
      { today: [], yesterday: [], lastWeek: [], lastMonth: [], older: [] }
    );
  };

  const groupedChats = groupChatsByDate(chats);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="p-4 text-center text-muted-foreground">
            Loading chats...
          </div>
        ) : !chats?.length ? (
          <div className="p-4 text-center text-muted-foreground">
            No chats yet
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            {/* Today's Chats */}
            {groupedChats.today.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-2 px-2">
                <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Today
                </div>
                {groupedChats.today.map((chat) => (
                  <ChatItem
                    key={chat.id}
                    chat={chat}
                    isActive={chat.id === id}
                    onDelete={(chatId) => {
                      setDeleteId(chatId);
                      setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                    }}
                    setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Yesterday's Chats */}
            {groupedChats.yesterday.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-2 px-2">
                <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
                  Yesterday
                </div>
                {groupedChats.yesterday.map((chat) => (
                  <ChatItem
                    key={chat.id}
                    chat={chat}
                    isActive={chat.id === id}
                    onDelete={(chatId) => {
                      setDeleteId(chatId);
                      setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                    }}
                    setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Last Week's Chats */}
            {groupedChats.lastWeek.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-2 px-2">
                <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
                  Last 7 days
                </div>
                {groupedChats.lastWeek.map((chat) => (
                  <ChatItem
                    key={chat.id}
                    chat={chat}
                    isActive={chat.id === id}
                    onDelete={(chatId) => {
                      setDeleteId(chatId);
                      setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                    }}
                    setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Last Month's Chats */}
            {groupedChats.lastMonth.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-2 px-2">
                <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
                  Last 30 days
                </div>
                {groupedChats.lastMonth.map((chat) => (
                  <ChatItem
                    key={chat.id}
                    chat={chat}
                    isActive={chat.id === id}
                    onDelete={(chatId) => {
                      setDeleteId(chatId);
                      setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                    }}
                    setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Older Chats */}
            {groupedChats.older.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-2 px-2">
                <div className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
                  Older
                </div>
                {groupedChats.older.map((chat) => (
                  <ChatItem
                    key={chat.id}
                    chat={chat}
                    isActive={chat.id === id}
                    onDelete={(chatId) => {
                      setDeleteId(chatId);
                      setShowDeleteDialog(true);
                    }}
                    setOpenMobile={setOpenMobile}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <AlertDialog open={showDeleteDialog} onOpenChange={setShowDeleteDialog}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Chat</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your
              chat and remove it from our servers.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete}>
              Delete
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  );
}

const ChatItem = memo(({
  chat,
  isActive,
  onDelete,
  setOpenMobile
}: {
  chat: any
  isActive: boolean
  onDelete: (chatId: string) => void
  setOpenMobile?: (open: boolean) => void
}) => {

          isActive && 'bg-accent'
        )}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
          <IconMessage className="h-4 w-4" />
          <div className="flex-1 truncate">{chat.title || 'New Chat'}</div>
          <div className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">
            <DropdownMenu>
              <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                <Button variant="ghost" className="h-6 w-6 p-0">
                  <IconMoreHorizontal className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>
                </Button>
              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
              <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
                <DropdownMenuItem 
                  className="text-destructive"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    onDelete(chat.id);
                  }}
                >
                  <IconTrash className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                  Delete chat
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuContent>
            </DropdownMenu>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
});

ChatItem.displayName = 'ChatItem';
```

This implementation:

1. Groups chats by date exactly like the Vercel implementation (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Older)
2. Uses React Query instead of SWR for data fetching
3. Provides proper loading states
4. Includes a delete confirmation dialog
5. Uses a memoized `ChatItem` component for rendering individual chats
6. Includes mobile navigation support with the `setOpenMobile` function

You'll need to make sure the `date-fns` package is installed for the date functions:

```bash
pnpm add date-fns
```

And ensure you have the necessary icon components in your `components/ui/icons.tsx` file. If you don't have `IconMoreHorizontal`, you can use an alternative or add it from Lucide or another icon library.

This implementation closely follows the structure and functionality of the Vercel AI Chatbot's sidebar history component while adapting to your project's specific libraries and components.
